title: Power-loss resume: no Klipper shutdown while homing X/Y (QIDITECH/klipper #18)

edits:
"M400", 
            "G28 X Y",
            "M400", 
            # q2-tweaked (power-loss-resume-homing): switch X/Y on (TMC set-up and phase offset)
            # before homing - not in the middle of the homing move (QIDITECH/klipper#18).
            "SET_STEPPER_ENABLE STEPPER=stepper_x ENABLE=1",
            "SET_STEPPER_ENABLE STEPPER=stepper_y ENABLE=1",
            "M400",
            "G4 P1000",
            "G28 X Y",

note: After a real power cut the X/Y stepper drivers come back reset. QIDI's resume sequence (virtual_sdcard.py) homes X and Y straight away; the steppers are first switched on by the homing move itself, and Klipper's TMC code then pauses the toolhead to measure the motor phase - in the middle of the homing ('drip') move. That raises DripModeEndSignal in the main loop: 'Homing failed due to printer shutdown', every time (reported with logs in QIDITECH/klipper#18 on a Q2). Fix, as validated there with repeated real power cuts: switch X and Y on, wait for the moves and one second, then home. Only the resume-after-power-loss sequence changes; normal homing is untouched. The same code is in 01.01.03.02 (and upstream Klipper's tmc.py still pauses the toolhead there).
